notes.title: FIRST MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
Dear Elves, 

We are happy to announce part of the changes we have implemented in A Very Bad Christmas Eve coming with today's update. 

[b](1)[/b] [b] Graphics overhaul and optimisation [/b] 

[b](2)[/b] [b] Manual [/b] - we added an additional Game Manual in the Main Menu

[b](3)[/b] [b] Different Game Difficulties [/b] - you can challenge yourself in “Terrible Elf”, “Bad Elf” and “Master Elf” Game Modes

[b](4)[/b] [b] Interactables [/b] - almost everything is interactable

[b](5)[/b] [b]Other[/b] small changes and [b](6) Bug fixes[/b]


[b][h3] What is coming next? [/h3][/b]

[b](1)[/b] [b] Up to three new Critical Machines [/b] 

[b](2)[/b] [b] Themed Rooms for every Critical Machine [/b] 

[b](3)[/b] [b] Leaderboards [/b] 

[b](4)[/b] [b] Achievements [/b] 

[b](5)[/b] [b] More Interactables [/b] 


Elves, let us know what do you think. Do you want us to implement some other features? 


We will be extremely happy and grateful to have you as a part of our inspiring community!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1480650/A_Very_Bad_Christmas_Eve/

[b][h2]We are social.[/h2][/b]
[b]Keep up to date with A Very Bad Christmas Eve on our social media channels:[/b]

[url=https://www.facebook.com/incinerationgames]Incineration Productions Facebook[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/incinerationgames]Incineration Productions Instagram[/url]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCc82aTXPQ6txudwM_QXKV9A]Incineration Productions Youtube[/url]

[b]Best wishes and thank you for being part of our community,
Incineration Production’s Team[/b]
